title: Nehemiah's Wall Dedication
description: After Jerusalem's wall was fully rebuilt, Nehemiah held a great dedication festival with two praise processions that walked in opposite directions along the wall and met at the temple with sacrifices and rejoicing.

versions.title: Nehemiah's Wall Dedication
versions.description: After Jerusalem's wall was fully rebuilt, Nehemiah held a great dedication festival with two large praise processions that walked around on the wall.
